name: After recital S
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Sb. whereas rising interest rates and borrowing costs have significantly reduced access to mortgage financing, discouraged real estate investment and reduced housing construction, thereby aggravating the housing crisis; whereas cumulative compliance costs, including those linked to energy efficiency requirements, further increase financial burdens on households and developers; whereas outermost regions face additional structural constraints, including higher construction costs and regulatory barriers, requiring proportionate and regionally adapted approaches; whereas excessive regulatory burdens disproportionately affect small property owners and individual landlords, thereby weakening an important source of affordable rental supply;
